'''Rostoni''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served on the crew of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Wanderlust]]'' under [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Daven Tam]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war they were hired by the Republic to transport [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
